note: Jo Daviess County's zoning districts are published only as PDF zoning maps (county Planning & Development page: low- and high-resolution map PDFs); the county zoning map is kept on file by the zoning administrator (County Code 8-3-3). The Galena/ArcGIS Zoning_Districts service found (services.arcgis.com/f4rR7WnIfGBdVYFd) is Fairbanks, Alaska data, not this county.
